question.text: What is the minimum SIP amount typically offered by most mutual fund schemes?

explanation.text: The Logic: SIP minimums are scheme-specified, but across the Indian mutual fund industry the most common minimum SIP instalment is around Rs. 500 per month. Many schemes go lower (Rs. 100 or Rs. 250). This deliberately low threshold makes mutual funds accessible to small retail investors and supports the financial-inclusion intent of the SIP product. The Trap: "Rs. 5,000 per month" and "Rs. 10,000 per month" are far higher than the typical retail SIP minimum and would exclude small investors. "Rs. 100 per month" is the floor a few schemes allow, but it is not the typical minimum across most schemes. Note: The specific "typical minimum SIP of Rs. 500" figure is not explicitly stated in the cited NISM Series V-B workbook pages (30, 142, 171); the workbook supports affordable mutual fund investing at Rs. 500 generally and states that systematic-transaction minimums are scheme-specified. The framing above reflects general industry practice across Indian mutual fund schemes.
